description: Morowa Dziewica, the Slavic plague maiden, a tall gaunt woman in a long grey shroud, her face veiled by a blood-red kerchief whose long end streams out in the wind, one bony arm outstretched, a sickly green plague mist trailing from the kerchief, withered grass at her feet, eerie and menacing, the whole figure inside the picture, full body, three-quarter view
